expectations.evidence: The answer rebuilds the page around a different goal, physical attendance. It argues that a signup form 'implies a step that doesn't exist' and makes 'Come' the action. It adds pieces that only an attend-without-registering page needs: a large 'No tickets. No registration. Just show up.' banner, a practical 'Plan your visit' section with transport, entrances and opening hours, and a capacity note because 'no registration at 3,000 people raises the question of what happens if it's full.'
